name: LCOV Coverage Viewer
description: Open lcov.info offline to browse line, function and branch coverage by directory and file, with hit counts and uncovered ranges on the source
help: Only the LCOV report and the source folder you choose are read. Nothing runs tests, builds the project or contacts CI; coverage is evidence of what tests executed, not a quality score.

Supported records: TN, SF, VER, DA (with checksums), FN (including the lcov 2 end-line form), FNDA, FNL / FNA, BRDA and LF / LH / FNF / FNH / BRF / BRH. Other record types are counted and reported but never used for statistics. A source file appearing in several test groups is merged: lines, functions and branches are unioned and hits are added, so nothing is counted twice.

Branch coverage = branches taken at least once / all branches; a “-” in BRDA means the block never executed, which counts in the total and is shown separately. A metric without records shows N/A. Declared LF / LH etc. that disagree with the actual counts are reported.

Set a source root to see hit counts on the source. When the report holds absolute CI paths, add “CI path prefix → local folder” mappings (longest match wins, Windows and POSIX paths both work). Only files inside the source root are read and escaping paths are refused; line numbers beyond the source and checksum mismatches are reported.
Large reports load as a cancellable task, the file list is paged, and summaries export as CSV or Markdown.
